Romanian Government Arice Scholarship 2026: Fully Funded Opportunity

The Romanian Government ARICE Scholarship, provided by THE ROMANIAN AGENCY FOR INVESTMENTS AND FOREIGN TRADE (ARICE), is now accepting applications for the year 2026/27.

Romanian Government ARICE Scholarship Abstract

  • Scholarship Host: Romanian Government 

  • Study Abroad: Study Abroad || Study-In-Europe 

  • Location: Romania

  • Category: Scholarships || Undergraduate Scholarships ||  Postgraduate Scholarships || Masters Scholarships || PhD Scholarships

  • Benefits: Full Scholarship

    • Tuition

    • Accommodation

    • Living Stipends

  • Eligibility: All Countries

  • Deadline: June 12, 2026

Romanian Government ARICE Scholarship Details

THE ROMANIAN AGENCY FOR INVESTMENTS AND FOREIGN TRADE (RAICE) announces the launch of the file selection process for awarding a number of 40 scholarships to foreign citizens to study in Romania starting with the academic year 2026-2027.

Studying in Romania provides a range of benefits, including access to quality  education, opportunities for employment during and after studies, a safe environment, and the potential for citizenship acquisition.

With its diverse academic offerings, vibrant culture, and relatively affordable living costs, Romania remains an attractive destination for international students seeking an enriching  educational experience.

Romanian Government ARICE Scholarship 2026 Benefits

  • exemption from the payment of registration fees or any other fees required by application processing

  • financing the tuition expenses for the Romanian language preparatory year;

  • financing the tuition expenses for the actual studies

  • granting a monthly stipend, for students enrolled in the Romanian language preparatory year;

  • granting a monthly stipend, for students enrolled in bachelor’s, master’s or doctoral studies

  • financing the accommodation expenses in the student dormitories

  • medical assistance in case of medical-surgical emergencies and diseases with endemic-epidemic potential

  • local public, ground, naval and underground transport, as well as domestic car, railway, and naval transport.

Romanian ARICE Government Scholarship Requirements

 To be considered for the ARICE Romanian Government Scholarship, you must:

  • be a foreign student, preferably outside of the EU (European Union) and EFTA (European Free Trade Area)

  • possess the relevant documents to apply for a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree.

  • be eligible to take a preparatory language course if you do not understand Romanian.

Required Documents for Romanian Government Scholarship

While applying for the Romanian Government Scholarships 2026, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • Application Form

  • Letter of recommendation

  • Photocopy of the diplomas obtained (high school diploma or its equivalent, bachelor’s, master’s, doctorate diplomas, if applicable) in Romanian, English or French languages, if applicable.

  • Academic Transcripts, authenticated by the competent authorities of the issuing country in Romanian, English or French languages, if applicable.

  • Applicant’s declaration that he/she did not benefit from another scholarship from the Romanian Government for the requested academic level.

  • Birth certificate 

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Medical certificate original

  • Identity card – photocopy and legalised translation

  • Copy of the first two pages of the Passport (valid at least 6 months after the beginning of the requested study program).

  • Two recent passport type photos

How To Apply for Romanian Government ARICE Scholarship

To apply for the Romanian Government ARICE Scholarship, follow the instructions we have outlined below; 

  • Click on the button below; it takes you to the scholarship announcement page

  • Read the English version of the Romania ARICE Scholarship under the “Short Presentation” Tab.

  • Read the “Announcement” in the next tab.

  • Check also the Selection Procedure and Application File tabs.

  • Download and adequately fill the scholarship application form
